_note: Rempo's claim rules, copied from the go-to-market build repo (rempogtmbuild, landing-page/copy-rules.json, which mirrors the GTM brain's rules/do-not-say.md). Applied to every word in content/ by tools/copy-lint.mjs on each build. refusalOk: the words may appear only in a sentence that refuses them (no, not, never, don't, won't...). allow: an exact content key where a rule is waived, with the reason (the copy file's own "allow" field works the same way).

rules.msg: Never promise reviews: describe the asking, not the result
The 7-day guarantee is PLANNED; no guarantees of results
No lift claimed for the personalized request
Approval mode is unconfirmed: no 'instant', 'automatic' or 'autopilot'
Only as a refusal: Rempo does not remove reviews
Only as a refusal: no review gating
The Run 2 offer is PLANNED: no prices or terms on the page
Name no job software as supported until product confirms it
